entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The next time we enter that Treasure[n]room will be after we send out the[n]calling card.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: In the end, that Kaneshiro bastard only[n]showed his stupid face once...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That doesn't matter. As long as we steal[n]the Treasure, we'll change his heart.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Then let's act as the Phantom Thieves[n]should and send the calling card. It's[n]on you, Joker.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If you wish to train or explore further[n]before sending it, that decision is[n]purely yours.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If we want to keep going, we'll need to[n]send out a calling card.
